source:
I want you to create a game that is very similar to Slap Tower in terms of gameplay and overall design, but make it your own original creation and do not directly copy any assets.

Requirements:

- A high-quality map inspired by Slap Tower.
- An Admin Panel that only I can access.
- The ability to send announcements or chat messages to all players through the Admin Panel.
- The ability to start and stop events whenever I want.

Events I want:

- Speed Event.
- Jump Event.
- Volcano Event (lava rises and eliminates any player who touches it).
- Low Gravity Event.
- Fog Event.
- Darkness Event.
- Rain Event.
- Wind Event.

I want the UI to be clean, modern, and easy to use. Make sure all features and events work properly without bugs, and the game is fully playable.

answers.ask: No world theme was given - should the tower read as bright and stylized, or as a grim volcanic structure to match the lava event?
answers.answer: Make it bright and stylized, with an original colorful obstacle-tower look; the volcano event should be a temporary gameplay effect rather than the map's permanent theme.

answers.ask: Is the win condition reaching the top, or being the last player left on the tower?
answers.answer: The win condition is reaching the top of the tower.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: No world theme was given - should the tower read as bright and stylized, or as a grim volcanic structure to match the lava event? A: Make it bright and stylized, with an original colorful obstacle-tower look; the volcano event should be a temporary gameplay effect rather than the map's permanent theme.
- [author] goal — Q: Is the win condition reaching the top, or being the last player left on the tower? A: The win condition is reaching the top of the tower.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a high-quality original 3D obstacle tower with a bright, colorful, stylized appearance. Build one continuous vertical route through several stacked obstacle sections, using a readable chain of platforms, climbing elements, and timed moving or disappearing obstacles that rises from the base to a clearly visible reward area at the top. Keep every section visually distinct while preserving a single followable ascent. Include a recessed lava basin at the tower base so a temporary volcano event can raise lava through the structure without making volcanic scenery the permanent theme. Do not copy protected assets, names, or exact designs from the referenced game.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Obby & Platformer, canonical slug `obby-platformer`, because players traverse a vertical obstacle route and win by reaching its top.

## Shape and preset
Use `course-tower`, spelled Tower / Spiral Ascent in Obby & Platformer, for stacked platforms that rise through one tower. Match the Tower Obby preset.

## Config requirements
Use `path-track` for the sequential vertical platform route, `obstacle-timing` for timed moving or disappearing sections, `obstacle-climb` for ladders, trusses, or wall-climb elements, `winner-zone` for the top reward area, and `hazard-kill` for the recessed lava surface used during the volcano event. Keep the lava visually secondary while inactive.

## Layout requirements
Place the layout half of `winner-zone` as one WinnerZone at the highest reachable platform. The rising height of the lava, speed, jump, low-gravity, fog, darkness, rain, wind, admin controls, announcements, chat, UI, event start and stop behavior, and player-to-player slap behavior are gameplay systems rather than additional static placements.

## Layout components
Create one vertical tower zone with a base entry, several stacked obstacle sections, sequential platforms, timed elements, climbing elements, open vertical gaps, one recessed base lava basin, and one top reward platform. Keep the route continuously traceable upward and frame the complete tower with a cutaway-like isometric view so stacked sections remain legible.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: establish the sequential platform route and valid connections first, then dress its stacked height slices and isometric view; the plan is authoritative because an impossible gap would break the game, while this non-maze, non-racing tower has no supported authored-plan generator.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use medium scale so the tower feels substantial while individual platforms and climb elements remain legible. The theme is an original bright, colorful obstacle tower. Use `P6` because the platform chain must be valid by construction and `P2` because stacked walkable surfaces overhang one another.

options.text: One continuous vertical, sequential platform route forming a single followable ascent through the tower.
Timed moving or disappearing obstacle sections within the ascent.
Climbing elements such as ladders, trusses, or wall-climb segments connecting stacked sections.
A clearly visible reward area / top reward platform at the summit of the tower.
A recessed lava basin at the tower base (visually secondary while inactive) used as a temporary volcano event hazard.

layout_placement.text: One WinnerZone placed as the top reward platform / reward area at the highest reachable platform.

layout.composition: Frame the complete vertical tower in a cutaway-like isometric view so the stacked sections remain legible, with the base entry and recessed lava basin at the bottom and the reward platform clearly visible at the top.

zones.name: Vertical tower zone
zones.role: Single continuously traceable ascent from base entry through several stacked obstacle sections to the top reward platform.

layout.theme: Original bright, colorful, stylized obstacle tower; lava/volcano is a temporary gameplay effect rather than permanent volcanic scenery.

render.why: The sequential platform route and its valid connections must be established first because an impossible gap would break the game.
